title: Mirexis
about: Lead a band of mutated colonists through turn-based grid battles. Build the settlement, manage faction pressure, and survive attacks from three powerful rivals.
Phase One: Isolation connects deterministic tactical missions to persistent recruits, colony construction, faction pressure, research, character events, and telegraphed colony attacks.

controls.desc: Manage the colony, select missions, move colonists, attack, and complete objectives
Confirm screens; tap CONTINUE or END PHASE for the visible equivalent
D-pad moves focus; A confirms; B cancels; X opens the log; Y opens help; Start ends the tactical phase
Save / load; tap SAVE or LOAD in the battle rail
Step back; tap the visible BACK, CLOSE, or RETURN control
